info.name: Campus Errand - Notification Service API Tests
info.description: F5 notifications through the gateway: auth boundaries, probes, empty-inbox contract and query clamping, the quiet ORDER_PUBLISHED receipt once the order is OPEN, the accept -> pickup -> deliver event chain with exact titles and bodies, no alert for the courier until the requester confirms (then exactly one ORDER_COMPLETED notice and, once Credit settles the escrow, one CREDITS_RECEIVED receipt for the courier), mark-read idempotency, unread filter, pagination, cross-user ownership, read-all, cleanup. Registers its own requester and courier (no seeded credentials). Run against a healthy stack: newman run tests/postman/notification_collection.json --env-var baseUrl=http://localhost (or :8080 with the port override). Residue: the two accounts delete themselves, but the order (COMPLETED, 3 credits), its five notification rows and both credit wallets remain, keyed by the deleted user ids; services keep no cross-database references, so this is harmless but visible in admin views. WebSocket push and broker-level duplicate delivery are covered by scripts/uat/uat-notifications.mjs, which the Postman runner cannot exercise.

item.name: 24 Non-numeric page and limit fall back to defaults

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('page=1 limit=20', () => { pm.expect(d.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.limit).to.eql(20); });
pm.test('Error message is a string', () => pm.expect(b.error).to.be.a('string'));
pm.test('Error message is a string', () => pm.expect(b.error).to.be.a('string'));
const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('updated=0', () => { pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.data.updated).to.eql(0); });
const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Parse error is reported, not a 500', () => { pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.error).to.eql('Invalid JSON request body'); });
const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('PENDING receipt with id', () => { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(d.id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/); });
pm.test('Page shape: items, total, page, limit, totalPages, unreadCount', () => {
const n = d.items[0]; pm.test('Item shape', () => expectItemShape(n));

pm.test('Publication receipt plus the acceptance, both unread', () => { pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(2); pm.expect(d.unreadCount).to.eql(2); pm.expect(n.readAt).to.eql(null); pm.expect(d.items[1].kind).to.eql('ORDER_PUBLISHED'); pm.expect(d.items[1].category).to.eql('PROGRESS'); });

pm.test('Identifies the errand (F5.1.1)', () => { pm.expect(n.kind).to.eql('ORDER_ACCEPTED'); pm.expect(n.orderId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); pm.expect(n.orderCode).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderCode')); pm.expect(n.title).to.eql('Your errand ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('orderCode') + ' was accepted'); });

pm.test('Identifies the courier (F5.1.1)', () => { pm.expect(n.courierId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('courierId')); pm.expect(n.body).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('courierUsername') + ' accepted your errand and will pick the items up next.'); });
const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('No alerts for the courier', () => { pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.unreadCount).to.eql(0); });
const n = d.items[0]; pm.test('Item shape', () => expectItemShape(n));

pm.test('Newest first and unread count 3', () => { pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.unreadCount).to.eql(3); pm.expect(n.kind).to.eql('ORDER_PICKED_UP'); pm.expect(d.items[1].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('n1')); });

pm.test('Identifies the errand whose status changed (F5.2.1)', () => { pm.expect(n.orderCode).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderCode')); pm.expect(n.title).to.eql('Your errand ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('orderCode') + ' was picked up'); pm.expect(n.body).to.eql('Your courier has the items and is on the way.'); });
const n = d.items[0]; pm.test('Item shape', () => expectItemShape(n));

pm.test('Receipt and three stages, all unread, all for this order', () => { pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.unreadCount).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.totalPages).to.eql(1); d.items.forEach((x) => pm.expect(x.orderId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId'))); });

pm.test('Prompts the requester to confirm (F5.3.1)', () => { pm.expect(n.kind).to.eql('ORDER_DELIVERED'); pm.expect(n.title).to.eql('Your errand ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('orderCode') + ' was delivered'); pm.expect(n.body).to.eql('Review the delivery and confirm it.'); pm.expect(n.actionType).to.eql('REVIEW_DELIVERY'); pm.expect(n.category).to.eql('ACTION'); pm.expect(n.orderStatus).to.eql('DELIVERED'); });
pm.test('Ordered by event time, newest first', () => { for (let i = 1; i < d.items.length; i++) pm.expect(d.items[i - 1].createdAt >= d.items[i].createdAt).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Stage order accepted < picked up < delivered', () => { const byId = Object.fromEntries(d.items.map((x) => [x.id, x.createdAt])); pm.expect(byId[pm.collectionVariables.get('n1')] <= byId[pm.collectionVariables.get('n2')]).to.eql(true); pm.expect(byId[pm.collectionVariables.get('n2')] <= n.createdAt).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 40 Wait for settlement (courier paid, proves order.completed was consumed)

exec: pm.test('Courier received the exact reward on top of the welcome grant (F4.4)', () => { pm.expect(d.totalEarnedCredits).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.availableCredits).to.eql(103); pm.expect(d.escrowCredits).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 41 Completion adds no requester alert and resolves the delivery action

exec: // Settlement has landed (40), so order.completed has been through the outbox and broker; keep watching for ~1.5 s more.

pm.test('Still exactly four alerts after completion, delivery no longer an open action', () => { pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.items.map((x) => x.kind)).to.eql(['ORDER_DELIVERED', 'ORDER_PICKED_UP', 'ORDER_ACCEPTED', 'ORDER_PUBLISHED']); pm.expect(d.items[0].orderStatus).to.eql('COMPLETED'); });
const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('4 unread', () => { pm.expect(d.items.length).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(4); d.items.forEach((x) => pm.expect(x.readAt).to.eql(null)); });

const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Returns the stamped row and the authoritative unread count', () => { pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.data.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('n1')); pm.expect(b.data.readAt).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.meta.unreadCount).to.eql(3); });

item.name: 52 Mark read again keeps the first read time (idempotent)
53 Unread filter excludes the read alert

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('3 unread, n1 excluded', () => { pm.expect(d.items.length).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.unreadCount).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.items.map((x) => x.id)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('n1')); });

const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('2 of 4, newest first', () => { pm.expect(d.items.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.totalPages).to.eql(2); pm.expect(d.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.limit).to.eql(2); pm.expect(d.items[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('n3')); pm.expect(d.items[1].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('n2')); });
pm.test('unreadCount is global, not per page', () => pm.expect(d.unreadCount).to.eql(3));

const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('Acceptance then the publication receipt', () => { pm.expect(d.items.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(d.items[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('n1')); pm.expect(d.items[1].kind).to.eql('ORDER_PUBLISHED'); pm.expect(d.page).to.eql(2); });
const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('Empty page, totals intact', () => { pm.expect(d.items).to.eql([]); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.totalPages).to.eql(2); });

item.name: 59 Requester unread count unchanged by the courier

exec: const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('Still 3 unread', () => { pm.expect(d.unreadCount).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.items.find((x) => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('n2')).readAt).to.eql(null); });

const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('unreadCount 0, every row stamped, n1 keeps its first stamp', () => { pm.expect(d.unreadCount).to.eql(0); d.items.forEach((x) => pm.expect(x.readAt).to.be.a('string')); pm.expect(d.items.find((x) => x.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('n1')).readAt).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('readAt1')); });
const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('No unread', () => { pm.expect(d.items).to.eql([]); pm.expect(d.total).to.eql(0); });
